The lighting is bright and even. (2) The shot cuts to the same two women; the friend is now holding a small white portable fan and a white suitcase. A variety-show style 'fire' effect with flickering orange flames borders the screen while pink stylized text appears in the center. The background reveals a wooden cabinet and shelves filled with miscellaneous household items. (3) The blonde woman is then seen in a hallway or different part of the room with another woman who has shorter brown hair and wears glasses and a light beige dress. The blonde woman uses her hand to count points, holding up one, two, then three fingers while speaking. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with white walls. (4) The blonde woman and the woman in glasses continue their interaction, both laughing and smiling. The blonde woman occasionally touches her hair or covers her mouth in amusement. The camera stays at eye level, capturing their upper bodies. Labels with arrows point to both women at the end of the clip.
